title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 317 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 317 - Punishment for using Fake Taxpayer Identification Number Any person who knowingly uses a fake or improper use of the Taxpayer Identification Number of another person shall be guilty of an offense and shall be punished with imprisonment for a term up to which may extend to such 1 (one) year or to a fine which may extend to Tk. 1 (one) lakh or to both.
